title: Colored Noise
text: 生成有色噪声信号；输出 1 路；按 {Noise color} 指定生成噪声的颜色；{Power of inverse frequency} 指定逆功率谱密度分量、{Guarantee the output is bounded (+/-1)} 指定将输出边界设置为 +1 和 −1、{Number of output channels} 输出通道数、{Output data type} 输出数据类型、{Number of samples per output channel} 输出的每帧采样点数、{Output sample time (s)} 输出的采样时间、{Initial seed} 指定随机数生成器的初始种子、{Simulate using} 指定要运行的仿真类型 Interpreted，按实例取值。

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: 有色噪声信号 scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Noise color
params.values: 生成噪声的颜色 pink (default) | white | brown | blue | purple | custom

params.name: Power of inverse frequency
params.values: 逆功率谱密度分量 1 (default) | scalar in the range [-2 2]

params.name: Guarantee the output is bounded (+/-1)
params.values: 将输出边界设置为 +1 和 −1 off (default) | on

params.name: Output data type
params.values: 输出数据类型 double (default) | single

params.name: Number of samples per output channel
params.values: 输出的每帧采样点数 1024 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Output sample time (s)
params.values: 输出的采样时间 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Initial seed
params.values: 随机数生成器的初始种子 67 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: 要运行的仿真类型 Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
